name: system_info
description: Returns CPU load, free memory (RAM), free disk space per drive and the PC's uptime.

keywords.en: memory ram cpu disk storage battery uptime free space
keywords.de: arbeitsspeicher ram cpu festplatte speicher akku laufzeit frei belegt

action.script:
$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
$cpu = (Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average
$uptime = (Get-Date) - $os.LastBootUpTime
"CPU load: $cpu %"
"RAM: {0:N1} GB free of {1:N1} GB" -f ($os.FreePhysicalMemory / 1MB), ($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize / 1MB)
"Uptime: {0} days {1} h" -f $uptime.Days, $uptime.Hours
Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Where-Object Used -ne $null | ForEach-Object { "Drive {0}: {1:N0} GB free of {2:N0} GB" -f $_.Name, ($_.Free / 1GB), (($_.Used + $_.Free) / 1GB) }
